facts.statement: A community event called a party on the jump platforms was scheduled at Playazul, on Server 1, for Thursday 4 November 2010 at 15:00 Pacific time for the US and Latin America.
facts.quote: Jueves 4 de Noviembre del 2010 15 hrs. Tiempo Pacifico (EE.UU. y Latino América) Servidor 1

facts.statement: The same community event was repeated for UK and Europe on Friday 5 November 2010 at 09:00 Pacific time (16:00 GMT), on Server 1.
facts.quote: Viernes 5 de November del 2010 09:00 hrs. Tiempo Pacifico / 16:00 Tiempo Europeo GMT

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language SOE news post announcing a Free Realms community event, a party on the jump platforms located in Playazul, held on two server-1 times for the Americas/Latin America and for UK/Europe. It also explains how players find community events through the Game Guide's Calendar button and teleport with the Go button. The page's posted date is only given as a relative age, so no exact article date is stated.
